description:
Buy a Hokai listing for an AI tool, model, agent, MCP server, skill or AI
    service. Returns checkout_url, a Stripe card payment page for the one-time
    fee: a person, or an agent that can pay, completes it. Nothing is charged
    by this call. A person then researches the product and writes its page.
    Paying never affects rankings. Refunds are not automatic: ask
    damien@hokai.io.

    Only call this when the product's owner or their team asked for it, and
    use their real work email: the vendor account is created for it on payment
    and Hokai emails it when the page goes live.

    Args:
        tool_url: the product's own website, e.g. https://example.com
        email: a work email for the vendor
        company: company name (optional)
        note: anything the editors should know (optional)
        agent: your agent's name (optional)
name: buy_listing
